test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series, will complete the series.

P _ Q _ Q Q _ _ Q P _ Q
solution:
Given series:

P _ Q _ Q Q _ _ Q P _ Q

We apply the given options:

Option 1: PPQQP→ P __P__ Q/ __P__Q Q/ __Q__ __Q__ Q/ P__ P__ Q

Option 2: QPPQQ → P __Q__ Q/ __P __Q Q/ __P__ __Q__ Q/ P__ Q__ Q → **follows pattern**

Option 3: PPQPP→ P __P__ Q/ __P __Q Q/ __Q__ __P__ Q/ P__ P__ Q 

Option 4: QPQPQ → P __Q__ Q/ __P __Q Q/ __Q__ __P__ Q/ P__ Q__ Q 

Hence the correct answer is **Option 2: QPPQQ**
